embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
fields.value: Huawei Research; **FLAG: borderline** (Huawei is not on the core tracked list — RF3DGS removes reflections from 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions by exploiting the fact that, across multiple views of the same 3D point, the darkest pixel is usually reflection-free.

fields.name: FlashMotion: Ultra-Fast Long-Term 3D Motion Generation
fields.value: Tencent — FlashMotion is a framework for generating long 3D human motion sequences — text-to-motion, music-to-dance, and speech-to-gesture — under a tight inference budget.

fields.name: Camera3R: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Camera Models
fields.value: Google; Ruxiao Duan and Alex Wong are dual-affiliated with Yale University) — Camera3R is a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) framework that extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction networks pretrained on perspective images to other camera models (fisheye, panoramic) without full retraining.

fields.name: Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
fields.value: Wayve Labs — The paper introduces "Spaghetti Splatting," a method for learning curve-like (curvilinear) 3D primitives directly from images via differentiable volume rendering, extending the convolution-based formulation used in EWA splatting and 3D Gaussian Splatting to one-dimensional, infinitely-thin geometry.

fields.name: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
fields.value: Alibaba; footnote states the work was done at ATH@Alibaba Group) — PhysOPSD is a framework for making video-generation models physically plausible by using executable simulation code as a "privileged" physical context during on-policy distillation, rather than relying on supervised fine-tuning or sparse physics-based RL rewards.

fields.name: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
fields.value: NVIDIA — HIST3R is a training-free framework for streaming 3D reconstruction that decomposes CUT3R-style recurrent state updates into a magnitude (how strongly a new observation is written into the scene state) and a direction (where the update moves the state), then rectifies the direction using locally con

fields.name: Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots
fields.value: Amazon — The paper introduces BCVS, a pose-free, correspondence-driven view-selection algorithm that runs at over 22 FPS on CPU to filter redundant frames from image sequences for real-time 3D perception on mobile robots.

fields.name: From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
fields.value: Roblox — The paper presents a framework that uses an LLM-powered coding agent to automatically build game environments, tasks, and scripted expert players from natural-language skill descriptions, which then generate keyboard-and-mouse demonstrations without any human gameplay data.

fields.name: Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models
fields.value: Microsoft Research — The paper argues that language-conditioned world modeling is fragmented across domains with different action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols.

fields.name: Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning
fields.value: Tencent ARC Lab; author-to-footnote mapping was partly garbled in the HTML but the Tencent ARC Lab affiliation is clearly listed) — The paper introduces Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL), a method for latent world models used in visual control planning.

fields.name: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
fields.value: SenseTime Research — BlenderFORGE is a training framework for open-weight multimodal LLM agents that edit 3D scenes in Blender by generating Blender Python (bpy) code.

fields.name: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
fields.value: Microsoft; other co-authors are University of Central Florida, University of Würzburg, Tsinghua University, UNC-Chapel Hill, UW–Madison — The authors introduce Video-Coder, a video-generation agent that writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene ("Draft Video") providing structure and motion signals to downstream video generators, rather than generating pixels directly.

fields.name: Left-Right-Consistent Iterative Stereo Matching via Cross-Injection
fields.value: Meta — The paper proposes cross-injection (CI), a lightweight add-on for iterative refinement-based stereo-matching models that produces mutually consistent left- and right-view disparity maps from a single pass, rather than two independent passes that often disagree.

fields.name: PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State
fields.value: Tencent; other authors: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Wellington College, Nanyang Technological University) — PlayGen2 is a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering, keeping a persistent world memory (a volumetric occupancy grid for static geometry plus identity-indexed 3D states for the player and other entities) and a separate neural renderer that t

fields.name: Householder Motion Embedding: Noise Modulation for Motion-Controllable Video Generation
fields.value: Amazon; his full-time appointment is at the Australian National University); other authors are at ANU and Vertex Lab Technology Limited. **FLAG: borderline** — The paper proposes Householder Motion Embedding (HME), a training-free way to encode motion control into the initial noise of a video diffusion model using a sequence of Householder reflections that form an orthogonal transform on each spatial location's channel vector.
